statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-117610 is a NULL pointer dereference in externalEntityInitProcessor2() in libexpat's lib/xmlparse.c, affecting libexpat through 2.9.0: the function mishandles the XML_TOK_NONE token from an empty non-final first parse of an external entity subparser, so a later parse crashes. libexpat 2.10.0 fixes it with https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1444, whose code change is https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/bfc28346fa3efeb8ca56c17437d24a7344e5feab (contained in the R_2_10_0 release tag), which adds an XML_TOK_NONE case to that function. For Alpine 3.23, 2.10.0-r1 is the first build of libexpat 2.10.0 in the DHI repository; no 2.10.0-r0 is published. Every earlier published build (2.7.3-r0 to 2.9.0-r1) is libexpat 2.9.0 or older. Checked the libexpat.so.1 library in every published libexpat package and the libexpat.a library in every published expat-static package, for x86_64 and aarch64: the XML_TOK_NONE check that the fix adds right after the initial tokenizer call is present only in 2.10.0-r1, so no earlier build carries a backport.

CVE-2026-117610 is a NULL pointer dereference in externalEntityInitProcessor2() in libexpat's lib/xmlparse.c, affecting libexpat through 2.9.0: the function mishandles the XML_TOK_NONE token from an empty non-final first parse of an external entity subparser, so a later parse crashes. libexpat 2.10.0 fixes it with https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1444, whose code change is https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/bfc28346fa3efeb8ca56c17437d24a7344e5feab (contained in the R_2_10_0 release tag), which adds an XML_TOK_NONE case to that function. Debian has fixed it only in unstable, 2.10.0-1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-117610 lists trixie's 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 as vulnerable). This owner backports the same xmlparse.c change onto Debian's 2.9.0-1~deb13u1, starting with the second build of that Debian version, which is the fixed version of this range; the third and fourth builds carry it too. Checked every libexpat1 and libexpat1-dev package published in the DHI Debian repository for amd64 and arm64: in those three builds the changelog records the backport, and both the shipped libexpat.so.1 and libexpat.a test for XML_TOK_NONE right after the initial tokenizer call in externalEntityInitProcessor2(); the first 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 build lacks that test. Every earlier build is libexpat 2.8.3 or older with no changelog entry for this CVE, and sorts on the affected side of this range.
